comparison.objective: Unlock a liquid-soap pump and leave it ready to press.
comparison.physical_skill: Counterhold and twist coupled pump components to produce relative head rise.
comparison.success_condition: Head rises at least 15 mm relative to an upright bottle; robot clears 80 mm and state remains stable for 21 samples.
comparison.reason: Thread/latch release with relative component motion does not test granular flow or aperture selection. No material rubric detail is missing.
